question: What is the name and capacity of the stadium with the most concerts after 2014 ?
gold_query: select t2.name , t2.capacity from concert as t1 join stadium as t2 on t1.stadium_id = t2.stadium_id where t1.year > 2014 group by t2.stadium_id order by count(*) desc limit 1

steps.raw_response: {"sql": "SELECT s.Name, s.Capacity FROM stadium s JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID WHERE c.Year > 2014 GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name, s.Capacity HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(sub.count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM concert WHERE Year > 2014 GROUP BY Stadium_ID) sub)"}
